name: Ledgy (Ledgy AG)
what: Equity-management software: cap tables, employee share and phantom plans, vesting, and global share-plan administration for private and listed companies.
homonym_note: Google News hits for 'Ledgy' also catch unrelated names (Bre Tiesi's son, Ledgre); the Zurich equity-management company is this one.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); press names Visionaries Club as a new participant in the Sept 2021 Series A and in the Sept 2022 Series B.
membership.quote: further participants in the round are Xavier Niel, Harry Stebbings, Visionaries Club

entry.quote: With its lead role in Ledgy’s series A round, Sequoia Capital

valuation.quote: No priced valuation published for the Series A or Series B.

notes: Entry: Visionaries is listed among the new participants of the Sept 2021 Series A, apart from the 'Existing investors Myke Näf, Paul Sevinç, btov Partners, Creathor Ventures and VI Partners' (Startupticker 2021-09-07), so the Series A is its entry. Follow-on: the EUR 22M Series B led by NEA, 'with participation from Sequoia Capital, Speedinvest, btov, Visionaries Club and VI Partners' (eu-startups 2022-09-21; the live page returns 403 to fetchers, so it was verified through its Wayback copy, web.archive.org/web/2022id_/...; the article mislabels the 2021 round as 'a Series B round at $10 million'). The 20VC sibling uses the same Startupticker line for 20VC's entry and notes the Harry Stebbings name is personal; that note concerns 20VC, not Visionaries. No round after 2022 found (googlenews '"Ledgy"' through Sept 2026: conference PR on TipRanks only), status private. Founded 2017 by ETH Zürich physicists (company About page: '2017 Founded', offices 'London & Zürich', 'Sequoia & NEA Backed by', '2025 Profitable'); the same page gives a EUR 1.2M seed before the Series A. HQ kept Zurich (Ledgy AG; both siblings), though London is now a co-equal office. Focus Fintech & Payments as both siblings (SaaS is the alternative).
